title: Mountain Dog Training - Embrace Insanity
author: Barry E.
desc: In this one, we are going to increase volume as we go, but from a training days perspective, not from a workout set # perspective. We are going back to 4 days a week for 3 weeks, and then will increase the number of trainings days to 5 from 4 as our “volume bump” for the second phase that lasts 6 weeks. The last 3 weeks the second Chest day is optional.
